meta.title: Sharp County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Sharp County's 2026 budget, set by Appropriation Ordinance #2025-4 (Nov. 25, 2025) and filed with the state. Amounts are the ordinance's maximum appropriations, split into categories using the attached office budget pages. Some money moves between county funds (for example $500,000 from road savings to road checking if needed), so those dollars can appear in two funds.

nodes.name: Courthouse Maintenance
nodes.note: The categories add to $147,647.00. The page then subtracts $19,667.00 charged to the Collector, Treasurer and Assessor and prints 'Cost to General' $127,980.00, the amount the ordinance appropriates. Printed total is $127,980.00; the categories listed add to $147,647.00.
